verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken layout. The logo and the 'SUNSET SALE' title shrink to tiny text in a cluttered footer, and 'SUNSET SALE' sits on a red ellipse cut off at the bottom edge. The 'Shop the Sale' button is jammed against the right edge on top of a brown circle, and the decorative circles are cropped into stray blobs, so the brand opening of the original is gone. B is slightly worse because its larger headline and wider spread push the product box (about 25px) and the button (about 13px) even closer to the canvas edges, while A keeps a little more margin.
